eps.ov: The 7th Squad may have settled into a new normal, but trouble soon follows when the commanders hold a meeting.
Ren grows increasingly interested in Yukki, especially once one of the Eight Thunder Gods appears in his room.
Yakumo wants nothing more than a harem full of women. But when she sets her sights on Yuuki, she just might decide to add him, too.
When Ren orders Kyouka to lend her Yuuki, the Supreme Commander unlocks a form befitting her power. However, even her might isn't enough to deny Yuuki a reward.
A contest will decide the next head of the Azuma Family.
Fubuki challenges Himari to a duel.
Kyouka notices how many women are growing closer to Yuuki.
When a Thunder God begins abducting women, the Demon Defense Force sends Mira and Kyouka to confront her.
Mira is a formidable fighter, but her opponent is a Thunder God. If she wants to win, she'll have to pull out all the stops.
Kuusetsu's new power makes her more dangerous than ever.
Yuuki and Kyouka have come a long way, and they've forged a bond strong enough to stand against a god. But even if they win this battle, the war is far from over.
In the aftermath, both the Demon Defense Force and the Thunder Gods prepare for what comes next.
